headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of October 16, 2026, the portfolio set is showing a year-to-date average return of 24.48%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 13.02%. This translates to an average alpha of 11.47%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has achieved a remarkable return of 38.45%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has returned only 2.65%, highlighting the variance within the portfolio set. Outperforming a broad benchmark like SPY is particularly relevant during periods of market stress or uncertainty, as it suggests resilience in the portfolio's performance. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
